description: This file defines the interface RetryTimeoutStrategy, which specifies methods for implementing a retry timeout strategy with increasing timeouts in a messaging connectivity context.

classes.name: RetryTimeoutStrategy
classes.description: An interface that specifies a strategy for calculating increasing retry timeouts, with methods to reset, obtain the next timeout, and track retries.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the timeout and the current tries.

methods.name: getNextTimeout
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next timeout Duration according to the retry strategy.

methods.name: getCurrentTries
methods.description: Returns the number of times getNextTimeout() has been called, indicating how many retries have been attempted.
